data.name: The Last Nordic Tribe
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever wondered what shaped the brutality of the Vikings and forged these fierce warriors?

The Last Nordic Tribe is an action survival game with light RPG elements, set in the brutal realities of the early Middle Ages. The game’s action takes place shortly after the Great Winter, known as the “Little Ragnarök” (536–539 AD), which nearly wiped out life in Scandinavia and left the world in ruins. This tragic period claimed the lives of 95% of Scandinavia's population, and the memories of these events were preserved centuries later on the Rök Runestone – a warning to future generations.

The game’s storyline was created entirely from scratch, based only on a handful of surviving historical sources. To give it greater depth, fictional elements were introduced — including an attempt to restore the Roman Empire in Britain and the concept of a new amber route that would transport slaves, furs, and amber from Scandinavia to Britain.

Your mission is to survive at all costs, using survival mechanics such as gathering resources and crafting weapons from available components, and facing an uneven battle against overwhelming threats - the freezing cold and relentless hunger. Encounters with enemies will provide not only valuable experience but also essential materials for survival.

The game recreates the atmosphere of the time – land covered in volcanic ash, barren trees, wooden buildings, and the characteristic aesthetics and culture of the early Middle Ages. All of this comes together to create a dark and immersive experience that transports players to a world marked by the aftermath of the “Little Ragnarök.”

Can you survive in a world where history was never meant to be so brutal?

data.short_description: Action survival game with light RPG elements, set in a brutal world shaped by the Little Ragnarok. Face hunger, frost, enemies, and fate itself in the dark beginnings of the Middle Ages. The fate of the North rests in your hands - will you survive?

content_descriptors.notes:
Adult content is an integral part of the game's narrative and reflects its survivalist nature, the harsh realities of early medieval life, and the overall tone of the world depicted. While such content is present, it is neither excessive nor graphic, and it serves a clear narrative and gameplay purpose.

The concept of "human meat" is a fictional survival resource, available only in extreme in-game situations. It is neither encouraged nor rewarded, and it is not depicted in graphic detail. This mechanic is grounded in the fantasy/survival setting and is not intended to glorify violence, cannibalism, or gore in any form.
